topic: Auto renewing car insurance every year vs shopping four quotes at renewal (Gus vs Winifred)

scenes.narration: Loyal customers quietly pay hundreds more for identical coverage. Today's training session begins now!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault in a gym holding two clipboards labeled AUTO RENEW and SHOP IT, comic burst banner reads LOYALTY TAX, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Gus and Winifred both insure identical sedans with clean records.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man gus and woman winifred beside identical sedans holding clean driving records, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Each pays one hundred forty dollars every single month.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, two insurance cards on a gym bench tagged ONE FORTY A MONTH, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Renewal arrives and the premium quietly climbs eleven dollars.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a renewal notice with a small arrow reading PLUS ELEVEN, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Gus never opens it, assuming loyalty earns him discounts.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man gus tossing an unopened renewal envelope aside, thought bubble reading THEY TAKE CARE OF ME, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Three years later he pays two hundred five monthly.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man gus straining under a barbell stamped TWO HUNDRED FIVE A MONTH, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Winifred collects four quotes on renewal day, every year.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman winifred at a table with four quote sheets spread out, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Same coverage, same deductible, compared line by line.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a comparison chart with matching coverage rows checked off, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: A competitor offers one hundred thirty two monthly.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a quote sheet highlighted reading ONE THIRTY TWO A MONTH, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Her old insurer matches part of it, so she switches.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman winifred signing a new policy while an old insurer waves a discount, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Winifred pays nine hundred dollars less every year.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman winifred flexing beside a gym scoreboard reading NINE HUNDRED SAVED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Shop four quotes every renewal, no exceptions. Drop and give me twenty bucks!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault blowing his whistle in a gym holding a clipboard reading FOUR QUOTES EVERY RENEWAL, comic burst banner reads TWENTY BUCKS, kids comic book illustration
